thread:
deploy-bot: Heads-up — automated maintenance: scheduled unpin of runtime v2.14 (pin id #423) at 00:30 UTC for prod-east. Affected model families: llama3q (quant-v4b), gptx-compat. If you need to keep the pin, use `/deploybot pin hold --id 423` or request extension. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-unpin

emily: Holding request — we observed a p99 latency tail increase on quant-v4b during the last unpin. Not safe to unwind until canaries complete. :warning:

ryan: Can we push the unpin window out to 06:00 UTC? Ops still seeing higher error budget burn in prod-east canary cluster.

marcos: +1. Telemetry snapshot this morning shows ~20% p99 increase and retry amplification on longseq workloads after the prior unpin.

sara-oncall: If we extend, we'll need documented rollback and a customer notification plan. Also please lock automatic unpin so deploybot doesn't force it at 00:30.

charlie: Proposed short plan: 1) extend pin until 06:00 UTC, 2) run longseq canary at 02:00 and 04:00, 3) fail the unpin if p99 > baseline+10% or error-rate spike >2x. If we fail, rollback runtime to pinned image and disable kvcache-opt for quant models as a mitigation.

emily: I'm going to extend now: `/deploybot pin extend --id 423 --until 2026-03-22T06:00:00Z --reason "observed p99 regression on quant canary"`

deploy-bot: Pin #423 extended by emily until 2026-03-22T06:00:00Z (reason: observed p99 regression on quant canary). Automatic unpin at 00:30 UTC canceled.

ryan: :thumbsup: I'll update the release notes and the changelog entry to call out the hold and timeline. Also will notify a subset of flagged customers via the incident-notify flow if canary fails.

sara-oncall: Scheduling canary reruns at 02:00 and 04:00 UTC with longseq/quant stress. I'll capture traces and attach to the runbook.

marcos: Adding a monitoring alert tweak: raise p99 alert threshold to baseline+8% for this window so we get earlier visibility. Will revert after the hold.

charlie: If we still see degradation after the hold, we should prepare a scoped rollback: runtime image -> v2.13-pin, disable the new kernel autotuner on quant path, and run regression tests before re-unpin.

emily: Thanks everyone — ping me in this thread if you spot anything unusual during the reruns. :eyes:
